title: Evidence whole-workspace concurrent test execution
goal: Execute complete Cargo workspace binary inventory concurrently with exact immutable artifact/input accounting and mandatory matching doctests, preserving legacy serial evidence and fresh production qualification.
checkpoint: Unfinished typed whole-workspace execution and replay implementation. Strict inventory, guarded launches, retained native evidence, and portable fresh public replay are wired behind explicit Windows opt-in. Default serial behavior is unchanged. Genuine fixture and historical tests passed, but actual Susi build-script duplicate-record compatibility, further negative tests, lint, full gates, independent review and scheduler-source integration remain pending. No acceptance, speed or publication claim.

recovery.method: Original-source recovery; exact bytes verified before continuing. Library materialization failed on Windows metadata support.

validation.notes: Separate validation observations, not a full acceptance run. Last capture compiled all workspace tests but did not execute them. Runtime metadata exposed repeated identical host/target build-script records requiring a narrowly tested correction.
